readmeExcerpt:
VoiceStudio

The local voice studio: clone, design, dub, dictate, transcribe and narrate in 646 languages.
Runs on your own computer and phone. No accounts, no API keys, and nothing leaves your device unless you say yes.

Website · Download · Get started · Docs · Discord · 简体中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Русский

Strategic sponsor

## What you can do | Create | Produce | Connect | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | Clone a voice or design your own | Dub videos with timed speech | Local API & MCP for agents | | Dictate with a floating widget | Stories, audiobooks & batch jobs | Reusable recipes & watch folders | Start with **VoiceStudio** (default, powered by k2-fsa/OmniVoice), or pick from dozens of other engines in the Model Manager. See the [features & engine catalog](docs/feature-catalog.md).

## Platforms | Platform | Download | Acceleration | Status | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **macOS** (Apple Silicon) | `.dmg` · [guide](docs/install/macos.md) | Metal (MPS) | Stable | | **Windows 10/11** (x64) | `.exe` · [guide](docs/install/windows.md) | NVIDIA CUDA · [AMD ROCm (opt-in)](docs/install/windows-rocm.md) · CPU | Stable | | **Linux** (x64) | `.AppImage` · `.deb` · `snap` · [Nix](docs/install/nix.md) · [guide](docs/install/linux.md) | NVIDIA CUDA · CPU | Stable | | **Docker** | [`ghcr.io/debpalash/voicestudio`](docs/install/docker.md) | NVIDIA CUDA · AMD ROCm | Stable | | **Android** 10+ | `.apk` · [guide](docs/mobile.md#install) | On-device, offline | Preview | | **iPhone / iPad** (iOS 17+) | `.ipa` (sideload) · [guide](docs/mobile.md#install) | On-device, offline | Preview | | **Windows on ARM** | `.exe` · [guide](docs/install/windows.md) | CPU (x64 backend under emulation) | Experimental | | **Intel Mac** | `.dmg` · [why](docs/install/macos.md) | App UI only, connects to a remote backend | Limited | Desktop and phone installers are on the [latest release](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/latest); Docker images come from GHCR. No GPU? The app is fully usable on the CPU, just slower. Native GGUF engines can also use Vulkan on AMD, Intel and NVIDIA GPUs; OmniVoice GGUF picks its GPU and model size automatically on Windows and Linux ([OmniVoice](docs/engines/omnivoice-gguf.md#vulkan-acceleration), [CosyVoice](docs/engines/cosyvoice-gguf.md)). Speed by engine and hardware: [performance](docs/performance.md). ## Get started **macOS / Linux** ```sh curl -fsSL https://voicestudio.sh/install | sh ``` **Windows** (PowerShell) ```powershell irm https://voicestudio.sh/install.ps1 | iex ``` Or download an installer from the table above. Then open **Voice cloning**, pick a voice or add a clean reference recording, type your text and generate. The app asks before it downloads any model. > [!NOTE] > On macOS, "VoiceStudio is damaged and can't be opened" means Gatekeeper blocked the app, not that the download is broken. See the [Gatekeeper fix](docs/install/macos.md#gatekeeper-quarantine).
More install options: a specific version, current main, uninstall, from source, with a coding agent ```sh curl -fsSL https://voicestudio.sh/install | sh -s -- --version X.Y.Z # a specific release curl -fsSL https://voicestudio.sh/install | sh -s -- --main # build current main curl -fsSL https://voicestudio.sh/install | sh -s -- --uninstall # remove the app, keep your data ``` If `voicestudio.sh` is unreachable, run the script straight from the repository: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/main/scripts/install.sh | sh`. Prerequisites and behavior: [installer guide](docs/install/script.md). **From source** ```bash git clone https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio.git cd VoiceStudio bun install bun run setup:api bun run dev ``` See [Electron setup](electron/README.md). **With a coding agent** (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, …), paste: ```text Install the VoiceStudio app on this device and verify it works, following https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/blob/main/docs/install/agent.md ``` Upgrading from 0.5.3 or older (the Tauri app)? [Install the new app separately](docs/electron-migration.md).

releases.name: v0.5.7 — VoiceStudio
releases.body:
**First, an apology.** This release took much longer than it should have. Urgent family matters kept me away for a while, and I'm sorry for the wait and for the issues that sat unanswered meanwhile. Thank you for your patience and for every report, fix and kind word in the meantime.

**Welcome Shimul Debnath ([velixio](https://github.com/velixio)) to the core team.** Shimul now helps maintain VoiceStudio — reviewing pull requests, triaging issues and keeping releases moving — so the project no longer waits on one person.

**VoiceStudio now runs on your phone and on PCs without a GPU, and the whole app is calmer.** Preview iOS and Android apps run models on the phone itself, GPU-less computers get the small CPU PyTorch build, and the sidebar, Models, Dubbing, Stories and Workflows pages were redesigned around fewer, clearer controls.

This release also adds an opt-in Beta update channel, a bottom player for takes, a GPU acceleration panel with honest Radeon reporting and the Ask VoiceStudio Agent, plus hundreds of fixes to cloning, dubbing, audiobooks, downloads and dictation.

releases.name: v0.5.6 — VoiceStudio
releases.body:
**VoiceStudio now talks to your other tools.** Answer Twilio phone calls in a saved voice, and connect Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI and the OpenAI Agents SDK to VoiceStudio with copyable setup that works, including in Docker, where MCP previously returned HTTP 405. Integration cards now say plainly which ones work with VoiceStudio and which are external links.

This release also lets you replace a saved clone's reference sample, clones long reference clips on OmniVoice, finishes long audiobook chapters on 8 GB GPUs, and keeps rendered chapters through a power-off or data-folder move.

aiSummary.oneLiner: A local-first application for voice cloning, dubbing, dictation, and long-form audio generation across 646 languages.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: VoiceStudio is a comprehensive desktop application designed for advanced, local-first audio processing tasks like text-to-speech, speech-to-text, and voice cloning. It fundamentally operates without requiring user accounts, API keys, subscriptions, or external usage meters, ensuring complete data privacy and zero ongoing costs. The software aggregates 16 distinct Text-To-Speech engines and 11 Automatic Speech Recognition engines to support an extensive catalogue of 646 languages. This makes it a highly versatile tool for generating long-form audio content, performing cross-lingual dubbing, and transcribing dictations natively on macOS, Windows, and Linux machines.
keyFeatures: Local-first architecture: Processes all audio and text locally without relying on cloud APIs or external subscriptions.
Extensive engine support: Integrates 16 different TTS engines and 11 ASR engines for diverse voice generation options.
Massive language catalogue: Supports voice generation and recognition across an unprecedented 646 distinct languages.
Voice cloning: Allows users to clone specific voices directly on their local hardware.
Cross-platform compatibility: Runs seamlessly across macOS, Windows, and Linux operating systems.

useCases.title: Private audiobook creation
useCases.description: Authors and hobbyists use the platform to generate long-form audiobooks locally without paying for expensive cloud TTS APIs.

useCases.title: Video dubbing
useCases.description: Content creators leverage the multi-lingual TTS capabilities to easily dub their videos into various languages.

useCases.title: Secure dictation
useCases.description: Professionals handling sensitive information utilize the offline ASR engines to transcribe meetings or notes securely.

useCases.title: Custom voice cloning
useCases.description: Game developers clone unique character voices locally to iterate rapidly on dialog without relying on external services.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: VoiceStudio is built for content creators, authors, and professionals who require high-quality, local audio processing capabilities. It is particularly suited for individuals who prioritize privacy, wish to avoid subscription fees, and need extensive multi-lingual support.
